messages:
Dorian H.: deploy-bot flagged RC-45: SBOM and vuln scanner disagree on nestedcodec. HIGH RCE in tensorops/libfast plus an unsigned codec binary bundled. Putting RC-45 on hold for triage.

deploy-bot: [sbom-scan] RC-45 -> HOLD\n- transitive vuln: tensorops/libfast: CVE-2027-4242 (HIGH, remote code execution)\n- nested license: third_party/nestedcodec: signature missing, license: unknown\n- artifact: /artifacts/rc45/sbom/1749999998/report.html

Sam R.: We were targeting a rolling global release at 02:00. Options: pin libfast to a patched backport (needs ABI check), or produce a shim without nestedcodec and use fallback codec. Shim likely fastest (~80m).

Keisha (sec): HIGH CVE exploitable from model input. Can't ship globally. Shim + runtime mitigations OK for limited canary. Apply `MODEL_SANDBOX=1` and reduce `MAX_MODEL_THREADS=4` during canary. Also run targeted fuzz on canary nodes.

LegalBot: If nestedcodec provenance is missing, redistribution blocked. Internal-only canary allowed if artifact removed and manifest proves it. Redistribution exception requires vendor provenance, attestation, or 48-72h review.

Dorian H.: Plan: build RC-45-shim (no nestedcodec), run US-west canary for 2h, expand if green. Sam, can you produce shim and manifest?

Sam R.: Kicking CI for shim now: https://ci.internal/runs/90045. ETA ~70m. Will upload manifest to /artifacts/rc45/shim when done.

QA Bot: Quick test plan queued: smoke, 10k inference sample, perf lap. ETA 45m after artifact available.

deploy-bot: ops snippets:
```
/deploy quarantine rc-45 --reason "sbom+vuln hold"
/deploy promote rc45-shim --region us-west --canary 1 --by @oncall
```

Sam R.: Artifact uploaded. manifest: /artifacts/rc45/shim/manifest.json. SHA: sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f... (truncated). nestedcodec NOT included.

LegalBot: Received manifest. Internal-only canary approved. Redistribution blocked until provenance is provided.

QA Bot: Tests complete: error rate 0.02%, p99 +21ms. Recommend canary.

Keisha (sec): Fuzz running on canary nodes; no crashes in first 30m. Sandbox flags applied as recommended.

Dorian H.: Starting US-west canary at 01:22 PT. Dashboard: https://metrics/release/rc45-usw-canary. Eval at 02:30 PT. Rollback triggers: crash, error >0.5%, or p99 >60% baseline.

oncall: Canary live, monitoring.

QA Bot: 60m in: stable. error 0.03%, p99 +23%.

Keisha (sec): 45m fuzz: no crashes. Will continue fuzz for full canary window.

Dorian H.: US-west canary stable at 2h. Recommend APAC soft rollout next but hold redistribution until Legal clears provenance. Creating remediation ticket SEC-1809.

LegalBot: Will engage vendor for provenance. If vendor provides signed provenance artifact we can accelerate redistribution approval; otherwise expect 48-72h. Will update thread.

Sam R.: Preparing a backport branch for libfast as fallback in case vendor provenance doesn't arrive in time; ETA longer.

deploy-bot: Reminder: global unhold requires explicit redistribution confirmation: `/deploy unhold rc-45 --by @Dorian H. --confirm-redistribution`

Dorian H.: Thanks team. Updating release notes to note shim usage, perf delta, and legal redistribution hold. Closing hold for canary regions only. :white_check_mark:
